messages: maya: quick design review request 1: compact trace header v2. main asks: (1) action grouping (copy/permalink/export), (2) keyboard/focus order, (3) contrast for corr-id pill. can we get quick takes? ari: saw the frames. i like collapsing copy+permalink into a single `Quick actions` popover (icon button). reduces visual noise and keeps the primary trace metadata left-aligned. jordan: popover ok but accessibility: the popover trigger must be keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded + aria-controls. inside the popover items should be // on click -> document.getElementById('copy-hint').textContent = 'Copied correlation id 123456.' ``` ari: keyboard/focus order note: header left -> corr-id pill -> quick-actions trigger -> other metadata. That order ensures screen readers encounter the identifier before export/permalink. small DOM reorder should be sufficient. lee: tooltip accessibility: tooltips must appear on focus as well as hover. use aria-describedby to associate tooltip text with the trigger for SR users. jordan: also add a skip-to-details link for power users so keyboard users can jump past header actions to the trace timeline. small link visible on focus only. maya: final thought: exported filename pattern should be `trace--.json` to avoid collisions and aid debugging. also tag telemetry event `trace.export` with corr_id and size. ari: thanks all. action items: (1) move export to kebab, (2) implement quick-actions popover for copy/permalink/share, (3) reorder DOM so corr-id comes before actions, (4) bump corr pill contrast + focus styling, (5) add SR copy hint + aria-describedby for tooltip, (6) export filename pattern + telemetry. i'll post updated comps later today. :raised_hands:
